verdict.rationale: Thoropass is a SaaS compliance platform, so a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents an MCP server and an llms.txt for the help center, but neither is an OpenAPI or equivalent API specification. Nothing in the pack mentions a public API spec that a user could download.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
